title: Lighting in courts and yards.
officialText:
In Group I-1, R-1 or R-2 occupancies, all yards and courts shall be artificially illuminated
with a minimum intensity of not less than 1 foot-candle (11 lux) measured 30 inches (762 mm) above the floor of the lowest level
of such yards or courts.
Exception: Such lighting is not required in an inner court that is accessible only from the interior of the building and to which
access is restricted for clean-out purposes.
SECTION BC 1207
SOUND TRANSMISSION
